bodyEn:
My Company
Work with AI teammates on coding, design, writing and data. The company entry is on by default for new users; you choose when to install a team. Open My Company → Add teammate, choose Wuwei One-Person Company and click Install to add six teammates and four departments. Chat with a teammate or create a group to work together. You can also ask AI to add teammates, change responsibilities and manage departments. Existing users can enable it in Settings → Company.

Image generation
Sign in, then choose Wuwei hosted · Image models below the message box. Select GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana or GPT Image 1. Describe your image and send. Confirm the coin cost to generate; the image appears directly in the conversation. No API key setup is needed.

Video creation models
Create videos with Grok, Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, MiniMax, Runway and more. Open Video Studio in the sidebar, describe your scene or add a reference image. Choose the aspect ratio, resolution, duration and audio options supported by your selected model, and review the estimated coin cost before generating. Preview and download the original video when it is ready. No API key setup is required.

Update to 1.7.69 and restart. Open User Guide in the bottom-left account menu for the new company and image generation instructions.

Experience improvements.
bodyZh:
一人公司
让 AI 员工分工协作，帮你写代码、做设计、处理文案和数据。新用户默认开启入口，团队由你选择安装。点击侧栏「一人公司 → 添加员工」，选择「无为一人公司」并安装，即可获得六位员工和四个部门。点击员工私聊，或建群一起完成任务；也可以直接让 AI 添加员工、调整职责和管理部门。已有用户可在「设置 → 一人公司」开启。

生图模型
登录后，在输入框下方选择「无为托管 · 生图模型」，再选择 GPT Image 2、Nano Banana 2、Nano Banana 或 GPT Image 1。输入图片描述并发送，确认无为币费用后生成，图片直接显示在对话中，无需配置 API Key。

视频创作模型
支持 Grok、Veo、Kling、Seedance、Wan、MiniMax、Runway 等视频创作模型。点击侧栏「视频创作」，输入画面描述，或添加参考图；按所选模型支持的能力设置比例、清晰度、时长及音频，生成前可查看预计无为币费用。完成后可预览并下载原视频，无需配置 API Key。

请更新到 1.7.69 并重启。详细步骤见左下角账号菜单中的「使用手册」，已新增一人公司和生图说明。

体验优化。
